metadata.datasource: From Fujifilm data sheet KB-301E (2003), FUJICOLOR POSITIVE FILM F-CP, 35mm Type 3510 / 16mm Type 3610; its curves, aim densities and printer settings also in Fujifilm's FUJIFILM MOTION PICTURE FILM MANUAL (KB-0707E, 2008), pages 25-28, whose plot agrees with the sheet's to 0.003 in density. Every plot read off the sheet's vector paths, each curve by its colour. Dyes: the sheet's three single-dye spectral densities, 400-700 nm, each less the floor the three share, half of what they add up to beyond the sheet's grey (0.02-0.08, Status A R 0.035 G 0.056 B 0.061): the film's base, which each single-dye density holds and the grey once, as the yellow and magenta curves show, lying flat at about 0.05 across 600-700 nm where neither dye absorbs. So taken they add up to the grey, kept as the midscale neutral, exactly; they are put on agx's dye-amount scale, a unit of each reading in its own channel what a unit of Kodak 2383's does. Base: the curves' own D-min, Status A R 0.087 G 0.089 B 0.153, as fog and stain, the dyes in the amounts that read it. Characteristic curves: Status A, exposed with 2854 K tungsten through CC-90Y, CC-60M and SC-41; the green and blue curves moved back by the 1.0 and 2.0 decades the sheet shifted them by, and converted into dye amounts with those dyes and that base; past its last plotted point (R 3.51 G 3.77 B 3.56) each continues as agx's curve model fitted to what is plotted, to D-max R 3.56 G 3.81 B 3.59. Mid-grey, as on every agx print stock: log H 0 in each layer is where it forms its share of a neutral grey of 18.4% luminance under agx's xenon projector (K75P), Status A R 0.77 G 0.76 B 0.76; the sheet's aim print densities (R 1.10, G 1.05, B 1.05) are a lab's for projection. Spectral sensitivities: the sheet's shapes, none beyond them; each layer's level from where its curve lies under the sheet's exposure, the CC filters taken as dyed gelatin of the sheet's own yellow and magenta dye shapes, the SC-41 as a sharp cut at 410 nm. Printed with agx's lamp, Kodak Vision3 250D prints neutral at M 66, Y 79 (on 2383 at agx's M 51, Y 54); all three levels moved together by +3.763 decades to collect as much of agx's printer lamp (TH-KG3) as 2383 does, each through its own filtration for Vision3 250D. The sheet's CTF (response 0.99 at 10, 0.97 at 20 and 0.79 at 40 cycles/mm) is not modelled: no print stage in agx or this app blurs. Printing lamp TH-KG3 and projector K75P as agx's 2383.
